description: Defines the CKEDITOR.scriptLoader object for asynchronously loading external scripts and executing code within the CKEditor environment.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.scriptLoader
classes.description: Object for loading scripts asynchronously within CKEditor.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads one or more external scripts asynchronously, with optional callback upon completion.

methods.name: loadCode
methods.description: Executes a string of JavaScript code into the current document.
